say:1:1510357001:0.text: Are you going to Halia, Herdmaster?

say:2:1510357002:1.text: Why do you want to help the humans?
say:2:1510357002:1.male: Why do you want to help the humans?
say:2:1510357002:1.female: Why do you want to help the humans?

say:3:1510357003:0.text: They took Mirehold and showed you such disrespect...
say:3:1510357003:0.source_cn: 他们抢走了雅库伯尔的水泽营地，还对您如此不敬……为什么？

say:5:1510357004:0.text: But you're already a good god. I don't understand.
say:5:1510357004:0.source_cn: 好神……但您之前就很好。加拉不明白。

say:5:1510357004:0.female: But you're already a good goddess. I don't understand.

say:6:1510357007:0.text: Why don't you just show your wrath and rain down fire on the Halians?
say:6:1510357007:0.source_cn: 为什么不降下怒火，对呼临人施以神罚呢？
say:6:1510357007:0.male: Why don't you just show your wrath and rain down fire on the Halians?
say:6:1510357007:0.female: Why don't you just show your wrath and rain down fire on the Halians?

say:7:1510357008:0.text: In our past, you destroyed our enemies completely...
say:7:1510357008:0.source_cn: 为什么不像记载中一样，让敌人彻底消失呢？

say:7:1510357008:0.female: In our past, you destroyed our enemies completely...

say:9:1510357009:1.text: I'll do my best to understand...

say:9:1510357009:1.female: I'll do my best to understand...

say:10:1510357010:1.text: I know you must have your own reasons for this.
say:10:1510357010:1.source_cn: 狩猎神大人这么做，一定有您的深意。
say:10:1510357010:1.male: I know you must have your own reasons for this.
say:10:1510357010:1.female: I know you must have your own reasons for this.

say:11:1510357011:0.text: You saw through the humans' tricks in an instant and turned away their warriors without spilling a single drop of blood upon Wildborn soil.
say:11:1510357011:0.source_cn: 您一眼就看破了人类的计谋，部落的战士一滴血都没流，就阻...

say:11:1510357011:0.female: You saw through the humans' tricks in an instant and turned away their warriors without spilling a single drop of blood upon Wildborn soil.

say:12:1510357012:0.text: I trust and believe in you.
say:12:1510357012:0.male: I trust and believe in you.
say:12:1510357012:0.female: I trust and believe in you.

say:13:1510357013:0.text: Where you go, I will follow.
say:13:1510357013:0.source_cn: 并且跟随您。无论去任何地方。
say:13:1510357013:0.male: Where you go, I will follow.
say:13:1510357013:0.female: Where you go, I will follow.

choice:8:1:2.text: The God of Harvest is watching. Be careful.

choice:8:2:3.text: This is my design. Trust me.

choice:8:2:3.female: This is my design. Trust me.

say:15:1510357005:0.text: But you're a god. Our lives are in your hands.

say:15:1510357005:0.female: But you're a goddess. Our lives are in your hands.
